_doc: Parameters for restyle.py (modern-vanilla look). k_min/k_max: palette size per unit. contrast: L is compressed around the unit mean by this factor. l_min/l_max: no pure black/white. warm_shift/cool_shift: b (and a for highlights) offset at the light/dark ends. chroma: saturation multiplier. denoise_passes: isolated-pixel clean-up passes (a pixel with fewer than min_same of its 8 neighbours in its colour takes the majority neighbour colour). soft_edge: put the middle palette step between light and dark regions that touch directly. seam_delta: luminance jump across the tile edge that gets blended. exclude_units: unit names to leave untouched.
